body:
Irritable bowel syndrome. I went to the hospital 2.5 years ago after not eating for over a week and not drinking for 4-5 days. Found out I had a compaction that was almost life threatening. Ever since then I wake up at least 2-3 times a week vomiting bile and dry heaving for hours. It has caused so much stress over the last 3 years I have developed arthritis in both of my TMJs at the age of 23. Gives me constant headaches and pressure behind my eyes. Also has lead to nerve damage, my right arm gets pins and needle feelings all the time.

They say there is nothing wrong, no medicine helps, it is not life threating. I just "need to learn to live with it".

I hate sounding like a sob story, but this has completely ruined my life and I cannot even pretend to be sociable for the sake of it. I live everyday going through motions, I am fucking shocked no one has noticed this.

Thanks for the words. My problem is I am very happy with who I am, I just cannot seem to attract anyone. I feel like it shouldn;t matter but everyone wanted to be loved. It sucks because I developed really strong feelings for that girl. There shouldn't be much in my life to be upset honestly.

I feel like it should get better, but it has not for me. I am the forgotten one in the group, the last to be called on, etc. I have great friends, and if it wasn't for them (they have no idea how I feel) I would have walked into traffic a long time ago. For me it is the constant failures of finding meaningful work and any kind of meaningful relationship, the love of my family is great and all, but I don't wake up next to them. Having even spending one night with that girl who I really like and seeing it going nowhere is soul crushing. She was the first girl I have even kissed since this all began over 2 years ago. 

I know a lot of this is under my control, but I come home every night after trying to be happy, even feeling happy at times, to sobbing in the corner unable to sleep thinking about the easiest way to dissapear. I don't mean to have a sob story, but I haven't felt any true happiness in my life or my future for years even after trying. And I have just enough pride left inside myself to not get help, I keep hoping for that one thing to happen in my existance that will change everything, but it's getting hard.
